newsitem.title: USA: Freeport-McMoRan Oil omits payout again.
newsitem.headline: Freeport-McMoRan Oil omits payout again.

text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Oil and Gas Royalty Trust said on Wednesday there will be no distribution for the month of February.
The trust last paid $0.008 in October 1995.
It said for the month of February 1997 the trust's class A costs exceeded gross proceeds by $1,232,717.53, which results in a cumulative cost carry-forward of $3,624,221.

In addition, the company added, net current month trust administrative expenses of $12.973 will be paid from the trust administrative expense reserve, resulting in approximately $1.9 million remaining in the expense reserve.
